powerName: Require vessel documents and examine or copy them
description: Section 9(1)(b)(i) states that the master may be required to produce a licence, permit, log book or other document relating to the vessel, which may be examined or copied.
conditions: The officer must meet the eligibility described in Section 9(1).
The purpose is ascertaining whether the requirements of the Act have been complied with.
The power is stated to be exercisable with or without a warrant.
limitations: The statutory text concerns documents relating to the vessel.
This record does not determine which document is required in a particular situation.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
